title: Days until a busier day
description:
An operations team wants to know, for each day, how long they had to wait until a strictly busier day arrived.

Write `days_until_busier(volumes)` where `volumes[i]` is the ticket volume on day `i`. Return a list where entry `i` is the number of days until the next day with a strictly higher volume, or `0` if there is none.

A nested loop works but is O(n²). Aim for O(n).

**Example**

```
days_until_busier([30, 20, 25, 40, 10])
# [3, 1, 1, 0, 0]
```
hints: Keep a stack of the indices of days still waiting for a busier day.
When a new day arrives, it answers every waiting day on top of the stack that has a lower volume. Pop those and fill in their answers.
Each index is pushed once and popped at most once, so the total work is O(n).
